PHASE.NAME: RTK Filter Trust and Verification Parity
PHASE.GOAL: Upgrade Synapse proxy filters to RTK-grade TOML schema compatibility, project-local trust gating, inline filter verification, and CLI controls so larger RTK filter corpus imports are safe and measurable.

STEPS.step-1: Added backwards-compatible RTK-style TOML schema parsing, inline filter tests, match-output rule guards, and trust-before-load for project filters.
STEPS.step-2: Exposed syn filters verify|trust|untrust|status command schemas.
STEPS.step-3: Implemented filter verification and trust command handlers.
STEPS.step-4: Kept proxy execution compatible with trusted project filters and built-in/user filters.
STEPS.step-5: Added CLI coverage for trust-gated project filters and filter verification.
